showcases.what_he_sees: A wrecked smelter in a ruin room, carried home by colonists, studied, made Kludged where it stands, studied again and made Refurbished with the one Ancient Component from the ruin.

The Factory tab with its parts and no production machine; the factory's machines in rows of Wrecked, Kludged and whole, told apart by eye; the alloy forge that gives plasteel only when it is Refurbished.

The two carried machines that nobody can build: a power cell that lights more lamps at each level and an emanator that calms more, both below the base game's own; and the Mod Settings line that gives either one back to the base game.

outside the promise of 0.1.0 (rule R_riders): it works as built until it moves, and its existing offline selftest with planted faults is the cheapest reading that the build did not break it
